rubrics.justification: The model appropriately stated that no image/Gardner score was available to it and avoided fabricating embryo morphology. It made only minimal contextual inferences rather than incorrect visual claims.
It thoroughly integrated age, AMH, maturation rate, tubal factor, BMI, endometrium, sperm parameters, and lifestyle with prognosis and embryo-selection uncertainty.

The reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, with probability estimates tied to age, reserve, and transfer context. Minor issues include somewhat speculative deductions and strong emphasis on alcohol despite limited effect size.

Much is guideline-consistent (SET, luteal support, counseling), but recommending routine PGT-A, ICSI for normal semen, DHEA/CoQ10, and broad embryo banking is more controversial and not uniformly guideline-based.
Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer and future cycles, though some suggestions are more speculative than standard-of-care and would benefit from stronger prioritization.
